text:
NinaK: Heads-up: planning a small edge rollout tonight 00:30 UTC for qkernel-v4.2-quant. This is the quantized build with a new kernel selection heuristic (prefer matmul-fused path on 80-bit FMA nodes). Requesting 8% canary for 25m and one ops lead on-call.
RahulP: ack. Which fleets qualify as edge?
NinaK: edge = us-east1-edge, ap-south-1-edge. Start with us-east1-edge only for tonight. ap-south to follow after a successful canary.
AlexW: clarification: this includes the thermal shim change too?
NinaK: yes, thermal shim + quant microops. We expect slightly lower p50 and hopefully better tail for long seqs.
PriyaR: rollback criteria suggestion: abort if p99 increases >12% OR any regression >0.4% on our eval-set (quant-eval/top-20) OR >2% failed requests (5xx). Also abort on repeated GPU thermal excursions (>90C for >1m) reported by prom.
RahulP: add a check for mismatch rate vs non-quant baseline >0.3% for top-5 prompts. Quant can introduce subtle diffs.
AlexW: good add. Make the monitoring group own the top5-diff alert.
deploybot: running preflight for qkernel-v4.2-quant on slice=us-east1-edge. Validating package checksum and canary smoke.
releasebot: quiet window reminder: 00:15-01:15 UTC. Approval required from eng-runtime leads + night oncall.
PriyaR: I'm oncall tonight. I'll take first responder. Nina, can you paste the rollback command?
NinaK: rollback (pin) command:```/deploy pin --project=runtime --version=qkernel-v4.0 --slice=us-east1-edge --reason="regressions"```
RahulP: small note: we should snapshot the KV cache metrics before cut so we can compare warmstart rates.
NinaK: done, snapshot taken and linked in the canary playbook.
deploybot: preflight passed: signature ok, smoke ok, kv-warmstart pass. Canary ready.
AlexW: kicking off 8% canary. Marco isn't around tonight so Rahul will watch metrics. Tossing heatmap and eval-run to the thread.
RahulP: canary live. watching dashboards: latency, kv-warmstart, top5-diff, error-rate, gpu-temp.
PriyaR: I'll monitor SLOs and escalate if something fires.
RahulP: 5m live: p99 +3%, p50 -4% (good), kv-warmstart good, top5-diff at 0.12% currently. No errors.
deploybot: canary at 8% for 10m elapsed. No primary alarms.
RahulP: 12m: noticed a burst of 500s from a routing shard r-47 for 30s window, ~0.9% of canary requests. Investigating.
AlexW: Is it correlated to the quant path? Check logs: model variant header and kernel id.
RahulP: logs show those requests hit the quantized kernel id=QK-FMA-80, but the error traces are upstream gRPC timeouts on r-47, not OOM. Looks like noisy network.
PriyaR: draining r-47 helped; error spike cleared. Mark incident: "routing shard transient 500s, drained". Continue.
RahulP: top5-diff nudged to 0.18% after the drain, still under 0.3. No thermal alarms.
AlexW: given the transient, we continue canary full 25m. If we stay healthy will schedule ap-south-1-edge roll tomorrow morning.
NinaK: I'll prepare the short release blurb and add a note about the routing shard noise and that it was unrelated to kernel.
releasebot: please remember to add the exact bake window and the rollback snippet to the release note.
NinaK: done: "qkernel v4.2-quant: kernel selection heuristic + thermal shim. Expect reduced tail on long contexts. Rollback: /deploy pin --project=runtime --version=qkernel-v4.0 --slice=<slice>"
AlexW: if anything breaches: immediate pin to v4.0 is approved. Priya will trigger and we'll open a postmortem if necessary.
PriyaR: standing by. thanks team. :thumbsup:
